stories.headline: Supreme Court refuses to allow Trump's mail voting restrictions for the midterms

stories.headline: Kosovo's ex-President Thaci convicted of war crimes, sentenced to 25 years in prison

stories.why_it_matters: The conviction will impact Kosovo's reconciliation process and international perceptions of transitional justice efficacy in post-conflict societies.
stories.perspective_one: Supporters of the verdict view it as a necessary accountability step for war crimes, reinforcing international law.
stories.perspective_two: Some critics argue the trial may deepen ethnic divisions and hinder political stability in the Balkans.
